content:
Mia Chen: Hey team, quick sync on Woodbine private deploy — they hit three blockers during week0 dry run: VPC route overlap, KMS alias permissions, and audit logs sink.
Aj Patel: saw the route overlap in the logs — their CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 overlaps our peered range 10.0.128.0/17. They need to either change or we can NAT the peering.
Ryan Long (Woodbine): confirming — our infra team can shrink to 10.0.32.0/19 if that helps.
Deepa Rao: Shrinking works but need to check security posture. Also KMS: their IAM role is missing kms:Decrypt on the alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/woodbine-redwood.
James Ortiz: I can patch the role, but want a quick policy snippet from Deepa we can apply.
Deepa Rao: attach policy: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/woodbine-redwood"}
  ]
}
```
Mia Chen: thanks. Ryan — FYI this policy will be applied to the role used by the private control plane. Confirm when it's done.
Ryan Long (Woodbine): role updated, policy applied.
onboard-bot: automatic check — KMS policy detected: OK.
Aj Patel: about audit logs — their Splunk endpoint uses a cert with CN mismatch. Logs failing to ingest. Need either a cert rotation or use our s3 fallback.
Ryan Long (Woodbine): we prefer Splunk but can enable S3 archive for now. How long can S3 retention be?
Mia Chen: standard is 365 days for onboarding bundle, but we can request extended retention as a paid add-on. For cutover we recommend keeping 90 days in Splunk + S3 long-term.
Deepa Rao: security ask — ensure CloudTrail has multi-region enabled and log-file validation on. That was off in the dry run.
James Ortiz: I've queued a runbook step to enable LR logging and validation. Will run tonight and post output.
Mia Chen: risk update for renewal — this delay pushes cutover 2 weeks. Flagging as medium renewal risk until logs + KMS + routes are green.
Ryan Long (Woodbine): appreciate the heads-up. Can we get a short checklist of remaining items and owners?
Mia Chen: yes — short checklist: 1) Network CIDR change (owner: Woodbine infra / Ryan) 2) KMS role policy (owner: James) 3) Splunk cert or S3 fallback (owner: Aj + Woodbine) 4) CloudTrail multi-region + validation (owner: James) 5) Post-cutover smoke test plan (owner: Mia).
Aj Patel: I'll take Splunk cert coordination. Please share the cert CN and endpoint via DM, Ryan.
Ryan Long (Woodbine): sending DM now.
James Ortiz: ran validation job — CloudTrail multi-region enabled, validation still failing because of an old S3 prefix. Asking Woodbine to create redwood-audit/woodbine/ region prefix.
Ryan Long (Woodbine): created bucket + prefix. Let me know when to re-run.
James Ortiz: re-run succeeded, logs flowing to S3 and Splunk fallback queued.
Mia Chen: great progress. Next steps: 1) Confirm final CIDR by EOD tomorrow 2) James to confirm KMS access logs and CloudTrail acceptance 3) Aj to verify Splunk ingest after cert swap or S3 fallback 4) I'll schedule cutover window tentatively next Wednesday.
Deepa Rao: one more security note — rotate KMS key material and set an access review for the role 30 days post-cutover. Ryan, can your team own rotation schedule?
Ryan Long (Woodbine): yes we can own rotation schedule, suggest a 45-day rotation window.
Mia Chen: ok locking action items. I'll update the onboarding tracker and set a renewal risk check on Friday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
